months.4: Mild temperatures and clear skies make this one of the best months for hiking the mountain.
months.5: The first rains arrive, but clear days still offer excellent, cool hiking conditions.
months.9: Fynbos blooms as skies clear, bringing excellent hiking conditions back to the mountain.

chicago.overview: The best hiking lies about an hour outside the city, where the easy to moderate trails of Indiana Dunes National Park cross wooded dunes to the lake. Closer in, the Palos Trail System offers easy to moderate loops through forest preserves. Spring and autumn bring the best weather, while winters are bitterly cold.

months.5: The moderate dune trails and forest paths are clear and green, offering the best hiking of the year before the heat sets in.

months.4: The hiking season hits its stride as the weather warms and the high peaks clear more reliably. The levada paths are lush and the ridge routes offer excellent views, though early starts are still best.

months.2: The trails dry out and temperatures begin to warm, offering clear views from the sandstone ridges with fewer hikers than the coming spring.
months.4: The hiking is at its peak, with perfect temperatures for the exposed red rock routes.
months.7: Intense heat and sudden afternoon monsoon storms make the high ridges dangerous, limiting safe hiking to short, early morning canyon loops.
months.8: The monsoon pattern continues with afternoon lightning risks on the exposed rocks, though early mornings offer cooler, quiet hiking.
